test_name: No automatic reports sent during staging playtest - a9950f46-5c43-400a-bf7f-81ca65aba248
summary: Passed because a Rumble round end now triggers the automatic report, and I saw that call happen in the editor. Automatic reports only go out at a few checkpoints: a single-player restart, after a single-player fight, and a Ball Tag round end. Rumble had none, so a playtest of only Rumble matches sent nothing. I added the checkpoint at the end of every Rumble round, the same way Ball Tag does it. The upload itself is skipped in the editor on purpose, so it still needs one check on a staging build.
instructions:
TASK: no auto-reports during playtest, why? we used to have a mechanism that for staging sends reports automatically

DESCRIPTION:
(none)

REQUEST (from Usul):
@Big Sys ship.

EXTRA (from the card):
Omer suggested the checkpoints might not be good for rumble, as a possible lead.

JOB TYPE:
BUG FIX - the task says a mechanism "used to have" auto-reports working and it no longer does, in staging/build

GAME MODE:
UNSURE - JUDE should decide from game context
verified: Shithole Rumble, Active->Resetting round end (HandleStateChanged invoked with copies of the live row): ReportUtility.TryAutoReportInBackground traced once, caller DeathmatchController.HandleStateChanged
Resetting->Active round restart: no auto-report call, respawn ran, no new console errors
not_done: Actual upload not observed: ReportUtility skips it in the editor (!Application.isEditor), needs a staging player build
Round end was triggered by invoking the state handler, not by a server round end (10 kills or a dev reducer on a shared database)
Did not check that the playtest build was built with STAGING_ENV - a build with no environment define falls back to Production and never auto-reports
console_errors: [FMOD] SystemI::getRecordDriverInfo : Invalid driver ID. (pre-existing, no mic on cloud machine)
DMGFX TurboOn - P.%100 Cannot find a controller to subscribe this DMGEventHandler to (pre-existing, at scene load)
